capabilities.name: Fail-closed public collection plan validation
capabilities.description: Validates a bounded non-personal collection plan against source metadata and explicit identity, policy, terms, privacy, emergency-stop, compliance and audit gate evidence.
limitations: No network requests, content collection, source execution or production authorization.

explicit_non_capabilities: Web crawling, scraping, downloading or authenticated API access
DNS resolution, redirect handling or SSRF protection
Personal-data enrichment, profiling or individual targeting
Legal advice or automated license interpretation
Durable audit storage or compliance certification
